items.lede: Some estimates say hackers stole billions in crypto from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, during a cyberattack on Thursday.
items.title: Binance pauses withdrawals as hackers suspected of stealing billions in crypto

items.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is investigating a potential security breach involving up to $5.8 billion in digital assets, in what could become the largest cryptocurrency hack in history. [...]
items.title: Binance probes potential $5.8 billion crypto-theft hack
